newsitem.title: FRANCE: French air cargo body to back smaller exec committ.
newsitem.headline: French air cargo body to back smaller exec committ.

text.p: The Comite Interprofessionel du Fret(CIF), a steering group set up by the air cargo community at the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle and Orly, is to hold its next executive committee meeting on June 6, a CIF official told Reuters.
CIF's executive committee comprises representatives from France's air freight forwarding agents(SNAGFA), airlines, customs and the Paris airport authority's (ADP) freight marketing department.

"At the June 6 meeting, we will approve proposals to tighten up CIF's organisational structure by reducing the executive committee to six members from 11. These will comprise a president, treasurer and secretary,and representatives from Air France the ADP and French customs," the official said.
"There will be a seventh person -- on part-time secondment -- who will serve as a kind of liaison officer between the CIF and the Paris air cargo community," he added.

The meeting will also review the work undertaken by CIF's commissions which look at specific issues in the sector including freight services, quality, logistics, customs and information technology, the official said. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
